# source (not executable): FlexiCT paper and pinned official evaluator: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21906 and https://github.com/ricklisz/FlexiCT/blob/fd74ac06a31813fe02805674e96f811e9b2a5c43/downstream/vlm/ct_rate_eval.py. The released method compares short positive and 'No ...' prompts with projected L2-normalized image/text embeddings and the checkpoint-learned logit scale. Mapping the local five abdominal concepts and normalizing five pairwise positive probabilities into one mutually exclusive distribution are explicit task adaptations.

class_assumptions.Cholezystitis: Dataset spelling is retained in outputs; prompt text uses cholecystitis.
class_assumptions.Normal: Normal is represented as a normal abdominal CT versus an abnormal abdominal CT; this is not one of the paper's 18 CT-RATE abnormality labels.

scoring.image_embedding: released 1024-D VLM projection of normalized CLS concatenated with mean normalized patch token, then L2 normalization
scoring.text_embedding: released Qwen3 text tower with last-non-padding-token pooling, then L2 normalization
scoring.per_class: softmax([positive cosine, negative cosine] * exp(checkpoint logit_scale))[positive]
scoring.five_class_probability: normalize the five pairwise positive probabilities to sum to one
scoring.calibration: none; probabilities are uncalibrated relative evidence
